environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) with a basic HTTP listener forwarding all traffic to the target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443/80 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request inspection or filtering rules configured on the ALB. The application runs as a Docker container with default networking.

config.alb: internet-facing, HTTP/HTTPS listener with default action forward to target group
config.runtime: Docker container, python:3.11-slim, no seccomp profile override
